{{Quote|We cannot overemphasize the importance of this mission, Captain. The future security of the Galactic Republic hinges on the destruction of this single weapon.|General Garza|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Battle of the Gauntlet''' was a military action undertaken by the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] to destroy the [[Gauntlet (Sith Empire)|Gauntlet]], a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] belonging to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the early days of the [[Galactic War]]. A faster-than-light hyperspace cannon mounted on a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]], the Gauntlet was to be put into mass production upon completion, but a combined attack by the [[Fifth Assault Fleet]] of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] under [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]] [[Numinn]] and several divisions of the [[Republic Army]] and the [[Republic Special Forces Division]], including the SpecForce units [[Havoc Squad]] and [[Safecrackers|the Safecrackers]], resulted in the superweapon's destruction.
